name: Interactive Barrier
description:
Inspired by the elegance of maritime design, the Noble Nautica
Interactive Barrier features touch panels seamlessly integrated
throughout the structure. Users can activate dynamic water effects
across different zones, creating an engaging and immersive aquatic
experience that reflects the sophistication and spirit of the sea.

name: WW-KWS- 01
description:
The WIBI Kids Water Slide is a dynamic, high-impact water attraction designed to
maximize fun and efficiency for any water park or resort installation. This modern play
structure delivers the excitement of multiple thrilling slides and interactive features while
adhering to a space-saving and cost-effective design.

name: WW-MBSWH- 03
description:
The WIBI Magic Ball Series Water House is a playful and modern aquatic attraction
designed for families to splash, laugh, and enjoy the thrill of water play together. Featuring
distinctive geometric “magic ball” structures, interactive slides, and dynamic spray zones, it offers
an engaging mix of fun, motion, and creativity.
Built with high-quality FRP materials for safety and durability, the Magic Ball Series combines bold
design with family-friendly functionality, creating the perfect destination for unforgettable
moments of aquatic excitement.

name: WW-MBSWH- 02
description:
The WIBI Magic Ball Series Water House is a playful and modern aquatic attraction
designed for families to splash, laugh, and enjoy the thrill of water play together. Featuring
distinctive geometric “magic ball” structures, interactive slides, and dynamic spray zones, it offers
an engaging mix of fun, motion, and creativity.
Built with high-quality FRP materials for safety and durability, the Magic Ball Series combines bold
design with family-friendly functionality, creating the perfect destination for unforgettable
moments of aquatic excitement.

name: Lazy River
description: Drift into pure relaxation with the Lazy River — a soothing aquatic attraction designed for endless leisure and family-friendly enjoyment. With its gentle flowing current, scenic curves, and refreshing atmosphere, the Lazy River offers guests the perfect way to unwind, float, and enjoy a calm water adventure at their own pace.

name: Kids Combination Slide
description: Double the fun with the Kids Combination Slide — a playful attraction designed to keep young adventurers engaged and excited! Featuring a mix of gentle slopes, mini twists, and multiple sliding paths, this colorful structure offers a variety of ride experiences in one compact design. Safe, vibrant, and endlessly entertaining, it’s perfect for creating joyful moments in any kids’ water play area.

name: Surf Simulator
description:
The Surf Simulator brings the thrill of surfing to any water park, resort, or recreational zone.
With powerful wave-generating technology and a sleek blue surface, it creates a continuous
flow that mimics real surf conditions—perfect for beginners, pros, and everyone in between.

name: Small Boomerang Slide
description:
The Small Boomerang Slide is a vibrant twist on the classic boomerang ride, designed to
deliver high-energy thrills in a space-efficient format. With a launch height of 15 meters, riders
in 2-person rafts plunge into a steep descent before rebounding up a curved slope—creating
a moment of weightless exhilaration before the final splash.

name: Small Tornado Slide
description:
The Small Tornado Slide is a compact version of the iconic funnel ride, designed to deliver swirling
excitement in a space-efficient format. With a 9-meter platform height, it’s perfect for younger
riders and families, offering a thrilling descent into a tornado-shaped funnel—all in a cozy
2-person raft.

name: Racing Slide
description:
The Racing Slide is a high-energy attraction designed for friendly rivalry and fast-paced fun. With
4 to 8 lanes and a towering platform height ranging from 15 to 20 meters, this slide invites guests
to race side-by-side—sliding headfirst on mats or body-style for a thrilling descent.

name: Rainbow Slide
description: Add a splash of color and excitement with the Rainbow Slide — a vibrant attraction that turns every ride into a joyful adventure! Bursting with bright, eye-catching hues, this slide delivers smooth, speedy fun as riders glide down a cascade of colorful waves. Perfect for kids and families, the Rainbow Slide brings energy, laughter, and visual charm to any water play area.

name: 4-person Super Bowl Slide
description:
The 4-person Super Bowl Slide is a show-stopping attraction in the Large Water Slides Series,
designed to deliver centrifugal excitement on a grand scale. With a towering 18-meter platform, riders
in 4-person rafts plunge into a high-speed tunnel before spiraling through a vibrant bowl
structure—culminating in a splashy, laughter-filled exit.

name: Bumblebee Slide
description:
The Bumblebee Slide is a vibrant centerpiece in the Large Water Slides Series, designed to
deliver high-speed fun with a splash of personality. With a launch height of 11 meters, this
slide sends 2-person rafts zipping through alternating yellow and blue tubes—mimicking the
lively spirit of its namesake insect.

name: WW-Space Bowl Slide
description:
The Space Bowl Slide is a centrifugal thrill ride that launches guests into a swirling vortex of
excitement. Starting from a 10.5-meter platform, riders plunge through a high-speed tunnel
before entering the iconic bowl structure—where momentum takes over and spins them into
a splashy finale

name: WW-High Speed Slide
description:
The High Speed Slide is a compact powerhouse designed for fast-paced fun. With a modest
3.20-meter platform height, this body slide delivers a quick adrenaline hit that’s perfect for
guests of all ages. Whether it’s a solo sprint or a friendly race, the slide’s steep incline and slick
surface guarantee a thrilling descent every time.

name: WW-Boomerang Slide
description:
The Boomerang Slide is a thrilling centerpiece in the Large Water Slides Series, designed to
deliver a dramatic drop followed by a soaring rebound that mimics the flight of a boomerang.
With a launch platform at 14 meters, riders in 2-person rafts plunge into a curved descent
before being swept skyward on a massive slope—creating a moment of weightlessness and
pure exhilaration.

name: Aqua Loop Slide
description: Take the plunge with the Aqua Loop Slide — the ultimate thrill attraction for adrenaline seekers! Designed for high-speed excitement, this dynamic slide delivers an unforgettable ride experience with twisting turns, rapid drops, and a heart-pounding loop-inspired adventure that keeps guests coming back for more. With its eye-catching design and exhilarating motion, the Aqua Loop Slide is a standout feature for any water park or aquatic destination.

name: Raft Spiral Slide
description:
The Raft Spiral Slide is a versatile gem in the Large Water Slides Series, designed to deliver
high-energy excitement in a compact footprint. With a platform height of 9.2 meters, this slide
sends 1–2 person rafts spinning through vibrant coils and tunnels, creating a ride that’s both
exhilarating and visually captivating.

name: Cobra Slide
description:
The Cobra Slide is a visual and sensory spectacle, coiled into the heart of your water park.
With a towering 17-meter launch platform, this slide sends riders plunging through the mouth
of a giant cobra—its scaled body twisting and turning in a thrilling descent designed for
2-person rafts.

name: Big Tornado Slide
description:
Big Tornado Slide – The Eye of the Adventure
Where gravity meets spectacle.
The Big Tornado Slide is a signature attraction in the Large Water Slides Series, engineered to
deliver high-impact thrills and unforgettable group experiences. With a towering 14.6-meter
platform, riders launch into a swirling funnel that mimics the force and drama of a real
tornado—only way more fun.

name: Phantom Slide
description:
Phantom Slide – Where Thrill Meets Elegance
Unleash the Spectacle.
Towering at an impressive 18 meters, the Phantom Slide is a showstopper in the Large Water
Slides Series. Designed for 4–6 person rafts, this attraction delivers a shared adrenaline rush
that twists, turns, and plunges through a vibrant maze of translucent tubes.

name: Big Family Slide
description:
Big Family Slide – Share the Thrill, Splash Together!
Designed for unforgettable group adventures, the Big Family Slide is a show-stopping
attraction in the Large Water Slides Series. With its towering 18-meter platform and vibrant
looping design, this slide delivers high-energy fun for families and groups alike.

aquatic fun. With towering slides, vibrant canopies, and jungle-inspired details, this installation

name: JGD-200BH Anti-Suction Main Drain
description: The JGD-200BH Anti-Suction Main Drain by Noble Nautica is designed to deliver maximum safety and performance for pool circulation systems. name: NN-SMD-1 Square Main Drain
description: The NN-SMD-1 Square Main Drain from Noble Nautica is designed for reliable and efficient water circulation in modern pool systems. With its sleek square design and durable construction, it provides both functionality and a clean aesthetic suitable for a wide variety of pool and spa installations.

name: MODEL-C NN-GCA GUTTER GRATING
description: The NN-GCA Gutter Grating Series from Noble Nautica delivers a robust and elegant drainage solution engineered for modern pool and deck systems. Constructed from UV-resistant ABS, this model combines durability, precision design, and superior aesthetic appeal to ensure reliable long-term performance in both residential and commercial installations.

name: MODEL-B NN-GBA Gutter
description: The NN-GBA Gutter Grating Series by Noble Nautica is crafted for superior strength, flexibility, and longevity in modern pool deck drainage applications. Designed to perform under continuous exposure to water and sunlight, these gratings offer both functionality and an elegant finish for any poolside installation.

name: MODEL-A GUTTER GRATINGS
description:
Gutter grating is molded in white UV-resistant ABS. The top features an anti-slip nish, and it is 
composed of individual units connecting along a central spine. This design allows for easier installation 
without the need for cutting, also allowing the grating to curve as necessary.

name: NN-Dosing Pumps
description: The NN-Dosing Pump Series from Noble Nautica represents a new generation of precision chemical dosing solutions designed for reliability, efficiency, and ease of integration. Engineered to meet the highest industrial and marine standards, these pumps deliver consistent, accurate flow control even in demanding environments.

name: NN-InfinityLine
description: The NN-InfinityLine from Noble Nautica is a premium continuous linear LED lighting system designed to deliver seamless illumination for architectural and underwater environments. Combining flexibility, performance, and durability, it provides a smooth, uniform glow ideal for pools, spas, and exterior accent lighting.

name: NN-FOL-EL-GMA (End Lit GMA Fibre Harness)
description: The NN-FOL-EL-GMA from Noble Nautica is a high-performance end-lit GMA fibre harness designed for precision lighting and signal applications in demanding environments. Engineered with advanced fluorinated polymer cladding and a step-index refractive profile, it delivers exceptional optical clarity, stability, and durability.

name: NN-Chem Dose
description: The Noble Nautica NN-Chem Dose is an advanced, intelligent chemical dosing system designed for automatic and precise maintenance of optimal water quality. Ideal for pool and spa environments, this system ensures the perfect balance of chemical parameters, eliminating manual hassle and maximizing user comfort and safety.

name: NN-MSS
description:
The NN-Mineral Swim system combines ozone purication
with premium minerals to create crystal-clear, fresh water.
Ozone eliminates bacteria and contaminants, while
mineral-rich salts provide softer, skin-friendly water for a
rejuvenating, spa-like swimming experience.

name: Orientable impulsion nozzle in stainless steel NN-SS-OI-316L  (marine quality).
description:
The Noble Nautica Orientable Impulsion Nozzle NN-SS-OI-316L delivers precision control, superior durability, and luxury aesthetics for high-end pools and spas. Crafted from marine-grade AISI 316L stainless steel, it is engineered to withstand saltwater, chemicals, and aggressive environmental conditions—ensuring long-lasting performance.

Its orientable eyeball allows you to easily direct water flow for customized circulation, massage intensity, or targeted impulsion. Combined with a brilliant polished finish and integrated electrical grounding, this nozzle offers a perfect blend of safety, versatility, and premium design.

name: Circular impulsion nozzle massage in stainless steel  NN-SS-CI-316L (marine quality).
description:
Elevate your aquatic experience with the Noble Nautica Circular Impulsion Nozzle Massage, crafted for premium pools, spas, and marine environments. Built from AISI 316L marine-grade stainless steel, this nozzle delivers a strong, invigorating massage while offering exceptional resistance to corrosion, saltwater, and chemicals. Its high-polish finish adds a sleek, luxurious touch to any installation.

Designed for durability, performance, and effortless integration, this nozzle ensures a long-lasting, therapeutic water flow that enhances relaxation and user comfort.

name: Impulsion nozzle massage in stainless steel  NN-SS-INM-316L (marine quality).
description:
The Noble Nautica Impulsion Massage Nozzle (NN-SS-INM-316L) is a high-performance marine-grade stainless steel fitting designed to deliver a powerful, smooth, and consistent water massage effect in luxury pools and spas. Manufactured from corrosion-resistant 316L stainless steel, it ensures long-term durability in saltwater, chlorinated pools, and humid environments while maintaining an elegant polished finish.

This nozzle features multiple precision-machined openings for optimized water distribution, creating a soothing hydro-massage effect ideal for spa zones, relaxation benches, and therapeutic massage areas. Compatible with ABS, liner, and stainless steel bases—as well as transition kits—it offers maximum installation flexibility across various pool construction types. Electrical grounding, secure screw fastening, and a standard 2" water intake ensure safe, stable, and professional integration.

name: Suction cleaner nozzle in stainless steel  NN-SCN-316L (marine quality).
description:
The Noble Nautica Suction Cleaner Nozzle (NN-SCN-316L) is a premium marine-grade stainless steel fitting engineered for reliability, safety, and long-term performance in high-end pools and spas. Manufactured from corrosion-resistant 316L stainless steel, this nozzle withstands harsh chlorinated and saltwater environments while maintaining a sleek, polished finish.

Designed for efficient suction cleaning, the NN-SCN-316L integrates seamlessly into concrete, liner, and stainless steel pools thanks to its compatible base options (ABS, liner base, or full stainless steel). Its low-profile faceplate offers a clean, sophisticated look while the threaded 2" water intake ensures strong connection and secure installation. Electrical grounding and screw fastening provide an added layer of safety and stability in all wet-area applications.

name: Box + trim in stainless steel NN-SS-BT-316L  (marine quality) with pneumatic button.
description:
The Noble Nautica Stainless Steel Box + Trim (NN-SS-BT-316L) with pneumatic button is a premium, marine-grade control housing designed for durability, safety, and modern aesthetics. Crafted from 316L stainless steel, it delivers exceptional resistance to corrosion, chlorides, and chemical exposure—making it ideal for pool areas, spas, water features, and humid technical environments.

Its satin-finished faceplate provides a refined, contemporary look, while the robust internal box protects the pneumatic mechanism for reliable, long-term performance. Available in single, double, and triple-button configurations, this unit offers flexible integration for air-activated spa systems, bubble features, lights, and auxiliary pool functions. Built-in electrical grounding and a secure screw-mounted design ensure maximum safety and stability in all installations.

name: Trapdoor in stainless steel NN-SS-TD-316L (marine quality).
description:
The Noble Nautica Stainless Steel Trapdoor (NN-SS-TD-316L) is a premium, marine-grade access solution designed for durability, stability, and a refined architectural finish. Crafted from high-performance 316L stainless steel, this trapdoor guarantees superior corrosion resistance—making it ideal for humid, chlorinated, or coastal environments.

Featuring a robust frame and precision-engineered lid mechanism, it offers smooth operation and long-term structural reliability. The 2B finish provides a clean, uniform surface that blends seamlessly with modern flooring materials such as concrete, stone, or tile. Available in multiple sizes, the NN-SS-TD-316L combines strength, aesthetics, and marine-grade protection in one elegant access system.

name: Overflow grid in stainless steel NN-SS-OG-316L (marine quality)
description: The Noble Nautica NN-SS-OG-316L overflow grid is engineered for pools that demand durability, elegance, and superior marine-grade performance. Constructed from high-quality 316L stainless steel, this grid ensures long-term resistance to corrosion, chemicals, and harsh outdoor environments—making it ideal for coastal installations, luxury resorts, private pools, and wellness facilities.

name: Anti-suction grid in stainless steel NN-SS-AS-316L (marine quality).
description: Ensure the highest standard of safety in your luxury pool or spa with the Noble Nautica Anti-suction Grid (Model: NN-SS-AS-316L). This vital safety component is designed to maximize water flow while preventing dangerous suction hazards, complying with stringent safety regulations. Unlike standard plastic grates, this unit is constructed entirely from marine-grade 316L stainless steel. Its high-density perforated design and robust construction ensure longevity and a premium, polished aesthetic that seamlessly integrates into the pool floor or wall.

name: Skimmer in stainless steel NN-SS-SKR-316L (marine quality)
description: The Noble Nautica Skimmer (Rectangular) (Model: NN-SS-SKR-316L) is a premium, wide-mouth skimmer designed to deliver superior surface water collection and chemical resistance, making it an essential upgrade for luxury pools. Constructed entirely from marine-grade 316L stainless steel, it provides a sleek, polished look that far surpasses traditional plastic alternatives, seamlessly integrating into modern pool designs. It features a practical, removable debris basket and is available in specialized models for both tiled (NN-SKRC) and liner (NN-SKRCL) pools.

name: Skimmer in stainless steel NN-SS-SK-316L (marine quality).
description: Maintain pristine water quality with the Noble Nautica Skimmer (Model: NN-SS-SK-316L). This essential pool component is engineered for efficient surface debris removal and superior chemical resistance. Built entirely from marine-grade 316L stainless steel, it offers an aesthetic and structural upgrade over traditional plastic skimmers. It features a large debris basket, a removable top grate, and is available in models for both tiled and liner pools.

name: Round drain in stainless steel NN-SS-RD-316L (marine quality).
description: Product Description: The Noble Nautica Cannon Flow (Model: NN-SS-CF-G-316L) is a versatile, high-arc, deck-mounted water feature designed for customizable aquatic display and hydrotherapy. Constructed from marine-quality 316L stainless steel, it is a statement piece offering robust performance and the flexibility of interchangeable nozzle tips to control the flow effect.

name: AquaForm Marine Shower in stainless steel  NN-SS-AFMS-316L (marine quality).
description:

Constructed from premium, marine-grade 316L stainless steel, it is guaranteed to withstand corrosive environments. The shower is highly customizable, allowing clients to choose from various integrated shower heads and mixer styles (cubic, rounded, etc.). Delivering a strong, efficient flow of water, the AquaForm Marine Shower is the definitive choice for a luxurious, durable, and reliable outdoor shower solution.

name: Colour AquaForm Rise Shower in stainless steel  NN-SS-CAFRS-316L (marine quality).
description:

This is a customizable version of the AquaForm Rise, featuring the same elegant structure and high-performance functionality, but finished in a selection of sophisticated colors to perfectly complement modern landscape designs.

It combines a simple, high-arcing design with an integrated mixer tap and a generous flow rate, making it an efficient and visually striking fixture for any high-end outdoor shower area. Choose a color that makes a statement or subtly blends with your existing aesthetic.

name: AquaForm Rise Shower in stainless steel NN-SS-AFRS-316L  (marine quality).
description:

Crafted from highly robust, marine-grade 316L stainless steel, the AquaForm Rise is designed for uncompromising longevity and is guaranteed to resist corrosion from the elements and pool chemicals. It features a simple, modern design with an integrated mixer tap and a generous flow rate, making it the perfect, durable fixture for any high-end pool deck or outdoor shower area.

name: Shower in stainless steel NN-SS-S1-316L (marine quality).
description:

This freestanding, minimalist column features a graceful curve that delivers a continuous, high-arching jet of water, reminiscent of a natural spring.

Constructed from premium, marine-grade 316L stainless steel, the AquaForm is guaranteed to withstand the elements and pool chemicals without corrosion. Its slender profile and integrated shower heads/spouts (optional) provide a quick, efficient, and stylish pre- or post-swim rinse. The AquaForm Jet Shower is a statement piece that embodies the Noble Nautica commitment to aesthetic durability and refined outdoor living.

name: Curved shower in stainless steel NN-SS-CS-316L (marine quality).
description:
Define your outdoor pool deck with the minimalist sophistication of the Noble Nautica Curved Shower (Model: NN-SS-CS-316L). This stunning, freestanding column shower boasts a singular, graceful curve, making it an architectural feature as much as a functional necessity.

Constructed from highly durable, marine-grade 316L stainless steel, this shower is built to withstand continuous exposure to weather and pool chemicals without corroding. Heat Pump is the smart choice for modern living.
